decision: Company Brain Batch 0C item 4: derive S028 from approved S027 frame 119; no new image unless deterministic derivation proves insufficient.

target.role: S028 motion base/start frame (shot-specific; not C1 canon)

frame_index_rationale: The approved S027 assembled shot (SHOT-EP005-S027-ASSEMBLED-v01, 7b01c392...8fde, row 6c290db5) used raw frames 0-119 at 24/1 with no resample (fps 24 -> 24, 1920x1080 -> 1920x1080), so raw frame 119 is the last picture the viewer sees in S027.
The raw source (lossless decode of the approved provider bytes) is used rather than the assembled mp4, which is a second lossy H.264 generation of the same frame.
Raw frame 120 exists but is not in the approved assembled shot; it must not be used.

operations: select decoded frame n=119 of stream 0:v:0 as rgb24
write lossless PNG (rgb24, bitexact, no metadata); verify PNG decodes to the identical rgb24 bytes

expected_frame_content: S027 end state at t=4.958 s: Mikko holds the blue cloth at chest height; Lumi floats holding the pink flower mirror upright; clean face, no smudges, clean mirror glass; same bathroom; knees-up medium-close framing.

interpretation_recorded.manifest_text: Lumi lowers the mirror to her lap
interpretation_recorded.approved_interpretation: Lumi lowers the mirror to a relaxed resting position in front of her lower body while floating.
applies_to: S028 motion brief (the lowering happens in S028 motion, not in the derived base frame)
S029 start/end-state continuity check ("mirror and cloth resting quietly in Lumi’s lap" read with the same interpretation)
interpretation_recorded.base_frame_effect: none: the derived frame is the S027 end state (mirror upright); no edit to the frame is required or allowed

continuity_check.overlays: none active in S027 end or S028
continuity_check.framing: S028 MEDIUM accepted in S027 framing (Batch 0 decision pack section 8); no reframe at the cut

insufficiency_test: Deterministic derivation is insufficient only if human QC of the exact derived PNG finds a defect (blur, artefact, wrong pose). In that case STOP and propose; no image generation without separate authorisation.
after_creation_required: human QC + APPROVE of the exact output PNG sha256
separately authorised production-storage write of the exact bytes
separately authorised registration as SHOT_FRAME/DERIVED_FRAME (shot_id S028) with the G04 provenance JSON

downstream.S028: base-frame-ready once this derived frame is approved and registered; still blocked by H1 Lumi voice, H4 visible speech, G09 dialogue overlap/hold guard, then one Seedance generation (separate spend authorisation)
